workflow_steps.value: Open audio (O) or drag-and-drop wav/mp3/flac (Windows drag-drop only) → waveform loads in ImGui/ImPlot view
Set Offset, BPM/base grid, Snap 1/1–1/192 (Up/Down for common, Shift+Up/Down for arbitrary) and toggle Zero-crossing / Silent tail remover / Fadeout

Add markers Z, navigate Left/Right (Shift+Left/Right jumps to snap), Ctrl+Left/Right jumps markers, click marker in table to jump, right-click to delete, Del/Ctrl+X/Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V to edit selection, Space to enter select mode
Preview current slice with P (auto-advance next) or Enter, optionally import markers from MIDI (Mid2BMS renamer array) or BMSE clipboard B
Copy markers: V = BMSE clipboard (rounded to 192nd), Shift+V = iBMSC clipboard (arbitrary >192 resolution), K = copy keysound list, Shift+K = append list to .bms in audio folder
Export: M exports sliced wavs (zero-cross & fade applied) + load/save project Ctrl+O/Ctrl+S; paste clipboard into BMSE/iBMSC/BMHelper to generate #WAV definitions and note placements

pain_points.description: Still requires manual clipboard ceremony: copy V/Shift+V → switch to BMSE/iBMSC → Ctrl+V. No direct BMS writing unless Shift+K and only if .bms in same folder. Virtual slices not native; export M still creates hundreds of files on finalize.
Zero-crossing moves markers to reduce clicks but invalidates iBMSC high-res clipboard; docs warn to fall back to BMSE 192nd-rounded clipboard if gamemode changes or missing keysounds after paste.
BPM changes only partially supported ('hackish'), grid display not BPM-aware; planned feature explicitly deferred. Users doing tempo-mapped stems must fake it.
File drag-and-drop only on Windows; macOS build unsigned (xattr -d required); nightly builds require GitHub login (or nightly.link workaround).
Export M still writes one wav per slice to folder; downstream definition reuse wizard needed to avoid 1296 base-36 overflow when slices >1295.

technical_limits.max_slices: 192th-rounded BMSE 1296 (01-ZZ base-36) or toggleable base-62 ~3844; practical limit is BMS 1296 unless LRbase62/beatoraja extended; no hard cap inside slicer
technical_limits.snap_denominators: 1/1 to 1/192 arbitrary snapping; BMSE clipboard auto-rounds to 192nd, iBMSC preserves arbitrary resolution over 192
technical_limits.bpm_handling: Partial BPM changes for audio slicing only (hackish); BMSE clipboard + full grid BPM import planned but not implemented; no per-measure BPM import yet
technical_limits.format_support: wav/ogg/flac via libsndfile + mp3; stereo preserved; exports sliced wavs with optional fadeout and silent-tail trim with configurable threshold

github_insights.issue_title: Skip iBMSC temporary file for keysound start detection / list add (commit b6aea7c)
github_insights.summary: Latest fix handles iBMSC temp files polluting keysound detection—shows fragility of clipboard/file round-trip that DJMax Studio virtual slices avoid entirely.

github_insights.issue_title: No open issues; nightly builds require login / xattr macOS quarantine
github_insights.summary: Repo has 0 open issues (2026-09) indicating small userbase/support burden; README warns macOS unsigned and nightly login friction—UX polish gap.

github_insights.issue_title: Planned: Better BPM change support (BMSE clipboard + MIDI import + grid display)
github_insights.summary: Author lists full BPM-aware grid as low-priority—validates need for DJMax Studio to do it natively with chart-ruler sync.

workflow_steps.value: Prepare loop wav (mp3→wav conversion required) — many tutorials warn 'mp3からwavに変換することを忘れずに！'
Generate source via BMHelper/Mid2BMS (MIDI → renamer array → concatenated wav + cut positions) OR load raw loop wav for butsu-giri manual cutting
Drag wav onto WoslicerII, set BPM/offset/fade (initmod patch zeroes fade/offset to fix defaults), add markers with Z / mouse
BMHelper: click '切断位置をコピー' → WoslicerII: File→クリップボード読込 → paste cut positions; verify filename in lower textbox (click black area if 総出力 disabled)
Click 総出力 to export hundreds of sliced wavs (01_000.ogg pattern) to BMS folder; then BMSE: drag-drop all wavs to auto-generate #WAV definitions
File→クリップボード出力 → enter start #WAV index in base-36 (01,02...ZZ) → BMSE/BMHelper paste to arrange notes; reuse definitions for repeated phrases to stay under 1296

pain_points.description: Three-app ceremony: DAW → BMHelper (MIDI→wav) → WoslicerII (clipboard read) → 総出力 → BMSE drag-drop → clipboard out. Single misclick breaks sync; '総出力が押せない' common when filename textbox empty.
Exports one file per slice (01_000.ogg…57_023.ogg); final folder lists 50+ slices plus Mid2BMS b_3x Osc files; manual naming/cleanup required, no virtual slices.
BMS base-36 WAV cap 01-ZZ = 1296 definitions; modern BMS still limited to 1295 (1296 inc 00). Exceeding forces risky definition-reuse wizard ('同じ音の定義を使い回す') or relegation to BGM (<60s) splits.

Win32 Japanese UI, no mouse polish; antivirus false positives ('ウイルス判定されて消された'); English patch by SayakaIsBaka required for non-JP users; abandoned—author says 'CAUTION: woslicerII is not maintained any longer.'
Fixed-sensitivity auto-slicing creates 'ズレ譜面' (drift charts) when transient detection misaligns; requires manual '犯人捜し' by converting text6_bms_blue.txt → .bms to diagnose.

technical_limits.max_slices: 1296 base-36 (01-ZZ) hard BMS limit; BMSE supports 01-ZZ only; exceeding requires reuse wizard or #BASE 62 extension (LRbase62) which breaks courses/Extra Mode
technical_limits.snap_denominators: Coarse snap steps via Up/Down; arbitrary 1/192 not native—must use BMSE rounding workaround
technical_limits.bpm_handling: Single global BPM/offset only; no per-measure BPM changes; off-grid loops require manual offset fiddling
technical_limits.format_support: WAV only input reliably; MP3 requires manual wav conversion; mono/stereo preserved but no fade/zero-cross preview in minimal version

user_settings.value: Fade / ずらし (shift) — traditionally 0 for butsu-giri

github_insights.issue_title: woslicerII_english initmod patch (fade/offset init to 0, FL 20.9 fix)
github_insights.summary: Community patch zeroes bad defaults (cutting volume enabled) that caused silent slices—shows legacy defaults harm UX.

workflow_steps.value: Drag wav onto mslider waveform (mouse-draggable markers, unlike II); click to add cut points while watching center line
Set BPM, ずらし 0, フェード 0 for manual butsu-giri; background waveform shows transient centers
File→クリップボード出力 → enter start definition number (base-36 01-ZZ) matching #WAV index of first exported file
総出力 to write sliced wavs; BMSE: drag-drop wavs to auto-define #WAV; Ctrl+V pastes sequence (start at #001, avoid #000)
For reuse: File→wosファイル読み込み Snare.wos → File→クリップボード出力 with existing #WAV01 to deduplicate repeated hits and stay under cap

pain_points.description: Virus false positives common ('woslicerIIIの方だとなんかウイルス判定されて消されたり'); users revert to II despite III mouse improvements. XP support only added Sept 2013, now abandoned.
Sequence encoding differs: III butsu-giri uses 'ファイル→クリップボード出力' vs BMHelper method uses '切断位置をコピー→クリップボード読込'; confusing fork wastes time.
Same 1296 cap; manual instruction '入らない場合は一部をBGMに回すか同じ音の定義を使い回す' pushes complexity to user wizard.
No longer maintained lineage; Be-Music Helper originally required II not III (later patched 2015); dependency drift causes version mismatches.

technical_limits.max_slices: Same 1296 base-36; no base-62 toggle unlike Sayaslicer; requires manual reuse for >1296
technical_limits.snap_denominators: Mouse free placement + coarse snap; no explicit 1/192 arbitrary listed—BMSE rounding required
technical_limits.bpm_handling: Single BPM; no per-measure changes; off-grid requires manual nudging
technical_limits.format_support: WAV primary; BGM split rule: '1分未満になるよう数個に切り出す' (split BGM <60s to avoid LR2IR blocks)

user_settings.value: BPM + ずらし (shift) + フェード (fade) all zeroed for butsu-giri
Start WAV index (base-36 01–ZZ) at clipboard export time

github_insights.issue_title: woslicerIII released May 2013, updated Sep 22 2013 to support Windows XP
github_insights.summary: Last official update 2013; author explicitly deprecated II at that date—both now decade-abandoned, justifying replacement.

workflow_steps.value: Compose in DAW, color-code tracks: Blue=keysound, Yellow=BGM, Red/Green=automation/portamento that cannot use BMHelper
BMHelper: load MIDI → auto splits chords, deduplicates same pitch (e.g., 9 unique notes from arpeggio) → output new MIDI + wav concatenation
DAW re-renders BMHelper's MIDI to wav (must trim reverb sends, watch volume; '音量に注意')
Mid2BMS [1]Mid2MML step, then [2]WaveSplitter: drop wav → auto-slices per note → generates 'renamed' folder + text6_bms_blue.txt
On failure, rename text6_bms_blue.txt → .bms and debug '犯人捜し' (missing definition or automation lane)
BMHelper: 切断位置をコピー → Woslicer clip-in → 総出力 → folder full of wavs ready for BMSE definition

pain_points.description: Cannot handle DAW-direct audio, compressor sidechains, or automation lanes (red/purple tracks). Docs: 'DAWに直貼りした音やコンプレッサーを使用したトラックなど、これらのソフトを使用することが出来ない音がある' — forces fallback to manual woslicer butsu-giri.
Mid2BMS failure mode opaque: '一発でうまく行かない場合があります' → manual text6_bms_blue.txt rename + folder dive. Three-app chain (Tools→Macros→Prepare to MIDI export → Mid2MML → WaveSplitter) fragile.
Shares 1296 WAV cap; BMHelper deduplication helps but rapid passages + chord splits still overflow; requires BGM downgrade or reuse wizard.
Usage declining: poll shows BMHelper users < Woslicer II+III combined; users migrating to Mid2BMS. BMHelper site is dead Geocities mirror (excln.github.io).

technical_limits.max_slices: 1296 via downstream BMS; BMHelper deduplication reduces count but cannot exceed; base-62 not supported downstream without patch
technical_limits.snap_denominators: MIDI tick-derived (480ppq) → BMS 192nd translation; off-grid MIDI requires woslicer manual pass
technical_limits.bpm_handling: MIDI BPM respected; but wav concatenation loses per-measure visual grid in slicer—only hackish partial BPM in Sayaslicer
technical_limits.format_support: MIDI in, wav out; renamer array import for Mid2BMS; reverb-tail trimming must be manual ('しっかり切るのを忘れずに')

user_settings.value: Mid2BMS checkbox trio (bottom 3 checks must match) or 'うまく行かない'
BMHelper track color-coding (blue keysound vs yellow BGM vs green manual)

github_insights.issue_title: BMHelper now supports woslicerIII as of beta 4' May 21 2015 (previously II only)
github_insights.summary: Dependency lock delayed adoption; shows ecosystem fragility when helper ↔ slicer versions diverge.

workflow_steps.value: Compose in PTSEQUENCER (used since DJMAX Online 2004-2008, still optionally used through Respect, new tool added DPC 2022 but old kept)
Assign keysounds to tracks; Respect hardware toggle 'Performance sound (key sound) playback ON/OFF' previews keysounded vs keyless stem mode
Export chart with keysound refs; tool enforces cap (1023 DJMAX pre-2025, 2047 since DPC 2025; EZ2AC EV 2047, theor. 65535)
Old formats: same-track polyphony limitation—continuous same keysound in one track not interrupted but overlapping different samples cut; Technika 2+ changed to non-interfering (all inputs don't cut)

pain_points.description: Hard cap 1023 (now 2047 since DPC 2025) far below BMS 1296+base62; high-density charts (post-EV 2000+ keynotes) cause racks/sinks if cap exceeded; EZ2AC theor. 65535 artificially limited because 'system cannot afford file load'.

Same-track cut model (pre-Technika2): new sample cuts previous in same track except same-sample retriggers; forces careful track allocation or song breaks. Technika2 fixed to non-overlap but legacy charts still bitten.
Distributed only via DPC leaks / internal use; docs say 2004-2008 tool with minor upgrades—opaque, no public undo/zero-cross guidance, forces BMSE-like external slicing for custom stems.
Respect collaborations often use keyless stems (per-hit samples replaced by phrase stems) to dodge 1023/2047 cap and cut voice—creates 1-min BGM block workflow instead of per-note keysounds.

technical_limits.max_slices: 1023 (DJMAX pre-DPC2025), 2047 (DJMAX since DPC2025, EZ2AC EV), 5000/9999 in EZ2ON Reboot:R, theoretical 65535 (2^16-1) but tool-limited
technical_limits.snap_denominators: Internal ticks; TECHNIKA touch grid uses 16th/32nd; RESPECT SC 8-10k charts use dense per-tick keysounds requiring >192 resolution
technical_limits.bpm_handling: PTSEQUENCER supports BPM changes natively (unlike woslicer), but legacy BMS export flattens to 192nd and can introduce drift if not quantized
technical_limits.format_support: WAV keysounds + BGM stems; keyless charts toggle; respects 60s LR2IR block limit for long samples

user_settings.value: Key sound playback ON/OFF (RESPECT system setting, audio buffer 64–2048)
Track allocation to avoid same-track cut (pre-Technika2) vs free overlap (Technika2+)

github_insights.issue_title: DPC 2022 incident FOX-B notes PTSEQUENCER cap 1023 < BMS 1296
github_insights.summary: Public admission DJMAX cap stricter than BMS; drives need for DJMax Studio virtual slices + mode switcher.

tool_audits.tool_name: FL Studio Slicex / dtinth sound-slicer (modern reference)

workflow_steps.value: Drag loop onto Slicex Channel Rack → auto beat detection (Dull/Medium/Sharp auto-slicing or grid slicing) creates regions
Manually adjust markers (Add/Remove, Trim all noise & slice up), set cut groups so slices cut each other, tune loop, normalize (Ctrl+N)
Assign trigger notes (Assign trigger notes to all) → KB INPUT or Piano roll: dump score to piano roll (stairs icon) → edit MIDI
Tools→ Drum(loop) Stretcher / time-stretch settings to handle tempo warp; workaround for mp3 gap (≈20-30ms) via Edison trim → save wav

pain_points.description: Tempo confusion: Slicex auto-matches master tempo but has no simple tempo knob like Fruity Slicer; users 'MIS-USE' tempo entry and BGA-like time-stretch fails on mp3 due to leading gap.
Normalize is lossy (phase manipulation) and cut groups must be set manually or tails overlap/click; auto-slice Dull/Medium/Sharp requires trial-and-error.
No direct BMS keysound export; must Edison trim → save wav → manual BMS definition. MP3 gap forces extra Edison step ('open in Edison → Trim → save as wav').

technical_limits.max_slices: Unlimited regions (practically DAW-limited, not 1296); assigns trigger notes per slice via MIDI
technical_limits.snap_denominators: Beat detection + grid; piano roll quantize via Dump score quantize option; tempo BPM only affects piano roll placement not sample pitch
technical_limits.bpm_handling: Time-stretch (Resample/Pro Default/Pro Transient) to match master BPM; beats property must be set correctly or slice pitch/duration warps incorrectly
technical_limits.format_support: WAV primary (MP3 gap issue); decks support two samples layered; articulator filters/envelopes per slice

user_settings.value: Cut group assignment (Set all cut groups to...)
Beats property (right-click BPM → set loop length) + time-stretch method
Normalize (Ctrl+N) + Trim all noise & slice up threshold

github_insights.issue_title: FL forum: Slicex vs Slicer tempo knob missing
github_insights.summary: Users expect simple tempo drag like Fruity Slicer; Slicex requires Drum(loop) Stretcher modal—validation for Studio dual-ruler where BPM is shared not duplicated.

strengths_sayaslicer.value: Arbitrary 1/1–1/192 snapping with BMSE 192 rounding fallback preserves timing while fixing iBMSC high-res gamemode-break bug
Zero-crossing toggle + silent tail remover + fadeout in one pane eliminates clicks without external editor
Dual clipboard (V BMSE / Shift+V iBMSC) + K/Shift+K keysound list covers both beginner and >192 workflow
Undo/redo, copy/paste markers, MIDI import, project save/load—none in woslicerII/III
Cross-platform C++ (Win/Linux/Mac), i18n (EN/JP/KR), base-62 toggle for >1296 charts

strengths_woslicer.value: Mouse-direct marker placement on waveform + center-line visual (III) is faster than woslicerII keyboard-only; Sayaslicer kept this
BMHelper連携 '切断位置をコピー→クリップボード読込' auto-dedup + chord split reduces slice count intelligently (e.g., arpeggio 9 notes vs hundreds)
File→wosファイル読み込み + clipboard export index input enables definition reuse wizard for overflow cases
総出力 one-click bulk export + BMSE drag-drop auto-define (.ogg/.wav) is familiar to veteran BMS artists
Community-verified defaults documented (BPM 0 offset, fade 0 for butsu-giri, start at #001 not #000) encode tribal knowledge

recommendations_for_djmax_studio.feature_name: Dual-ruler chart preview (waveform bottom + Studio timeline top, shared BPM/BP grid, synced playhead)
recommendations_for_djmax_studio.rationale: Fixes P0 export ceremony and P1 BPM hackish: slices instantly appear as notes in Studio preview, eliminating BMSE clipboard round-trip and tempo-misalignment drift seen in auto-slicing ('ズレ譜面'). Validates virtual slices before export.

recommendations_for_djmax_studio.feature_name: 192 quantize + BPM sync (Wave ticks ↔ Studio 192nd, per-measure BPM changes from Studio chart)
recommendations_for_djmax_studio.rationale: Replaces hackish partial BPM in Sayaslicer; quantization happens on Studio's authoritative BPM map so BMSE 192 rounding and iBMSC arbitrary res both stay in sync and zero-cross nudge keeps 192 alignment.

recommendations_for_djmax_studio.feature_name: Mode switcher BMS (1296/base62) | RESPECT (1023/2047, keyless stem toggle) | TECHNIKA (non-overlap polyphony)
recommendations_for_djmax_studio.rationale: One UI handles three ecosystems: BMS legacy cap & base-36 Zorg, Respect 1023→2047 cap + keyless stem downgrade path, Technika2+ 'does not interfere' model. Prevents cap surprises and same-track cut bugs.

recommendations_for_djmax_studio.feature_name: Virtual slices backend {sourceFile,startMs,endMs} with lazy wav/ogg export only on Finalize
recommendations_for_djmax_studio.rationale: Eliminates P0 file_management (hundreds of wavs, 01_000.ogg spam) and overflow anxiety: unlimited virtual slices until export, deduplicate via hash, and split >60s longs automatically for LR2IR compliance.

recommendations_for_djmax_studio.feature_name: Per-slice Zero-X nudge + FADE + Normalize preview with pre/post audition A/B
recommendations_for_djmax_studio.rationale: Makes silent-tail/fade/zero-cross non-destructive toggles with waveform overlay (red→green cross) and audition button; solves click artifacts without moving markers out of 192 grid.

recommendations_for_djmax_studio.feature_name: Round-trip Import to Studio (Slicer → project tracks with UndoRedoAction group)
recommendations_for_djmax_studio.rationale: Replaces clipboard ceremony: one button creates chart notes + #WAV defs in Studio project with single undo. No BMSE drag-drop, no 36-base index typing.

recommendations_for_djmax_studio.feature_name: Auto-advance Grid/Beat/Off with 192 snapping in Create/Delete/Place flow
recommendations_for_djmax_studio.rationale: Borrow Sayaslicer snap controls (Up/Down, Shift+Up/Down) and keep Studio's ComputeAutoAdvanceMs+QuantizeMs so holding D/F/J/K rapid slices stays bar-aligned.

recommendations_for_djmax_studio.feature_name: Slice Library table (1380×860) with search, Lane hint (D/F/J/K), duration, Zero-X/FADE badges, P audition
recommendations_for_djmax_studio.rationale: Modernizes woslicer's table-click-to-jump + P preview; gives creators instant feedback and lane plan without exporting.

recommendations_for_djmax_studio.feature_name: Overflow guardrail: live cap meter (1296/2047) + auto reuse suggestions for repeated phrase
recommendations_for_djmax_studio.rationale: Turns tribal '定義を使い回す' wizard into live UI: when virtual slices exceed mode cap, highlight duplicates and offer one-click reuse mapping or BGM-stem downgrade.

recommendations_for_djmax_studio.feature_name: MP3→WAV auto-convert + Edison-style trim for leading gap, keep source intact
recommendations_for_djmax_studio.rationale: Removes woslicerII pitfall 'mp3からwavに変換を忘れずに' and Slicex 20-30ms mp3 gap by auto-transcoding with gap trim preview, while preserving original for virtual slices.

recommendations_for_djmax_studio.feature_name: Keyboard map preserved (O/Z/C/V/B/K/M/P/Del + Ctrl+Z/Y, D/F/J/K lane hints, Home/End/Left/Right snap jumps)
recommendations_for_djmax_studio.rationale: Creatures of habit: keep woslicer muscle memory; layout-aware shortcuts and Ctrl+Left/Right marker jumps minimize retraining.

recommendations_for_djmax_studio.feature_name: Long-sample watchdog (>60s LR2IR block + 60s BGM split suggestion)
recommendations_for_djmax_studio.rationale: Warns when BGM/stem slices exceed 60s and offers auto-split '1分未満になるよう数個に切り出す' before export, preventing LR2IR rejects.

source_citations.translated_quote: Zero-crossing markers can help reducing clicks but also moves markers, which may affect iBMSC clipboard (arbitrary resolution). If missing keysounds or gamemode change, use BMSE clipboard which rounds to 192nd.
woslicerII_s_eng_initmod initializes fadeout, offset to 0 and disables cutting volume on startup — fixing bad legacy defaults.
If total output button cannot be pressed, filename not shown in lower textbox — click the black area on the right to show it.
BMHelper method is recommended (easy, auto chord split, duplicate reuse) but for automation tracks use direct butsu-giri in woslicer.
Auto-slicing at fixed intervals is easy but slight shifts causeズレ譜面 (drift charts); manual adjustment required.
If definitions don't fit 1296, put some parts to BGM (split <1 minute) or reuse the same definition.
For woslicerIII butsu-giri, choose definition start number in base-36 (01,02…ZZ) same as Mid2BMS start WAV.
Don't forget to convert mp3 to wav! Then reference slice-marker copy-paste to adjust drift.
WoslicerIII often flagged by antivirus and deleted, so I use woslicerII — try it if you haven't.
BMHelper shares weakness: cannot handle sounds pasted directly in DAW or tracks using compressor — must use woslicer.
Set BPM, shift 0, fade 0, watch center line while adding markers, then Total Output; specify start WAV number in 36-base.
Modern BMS supports 1295 (1296) kinds 01-ZZ; early was 256 (00-FF hex), pre-modern 576 (0-9A-F + 0-9A-Za-z).
Two-letter keys limited to 1,296 (36*36) seriously limited complex BGA overlays, leading to direct movie files.
Key sound count theoretically 65535 but limited to 2047 because loading too many files overwhelms system; PTSEQUENCER caps 1023 for DJMAX (now 2047 since DPC 2025).
In same track only one sample plays: new keysound cuts previous except same-sample overlaps are not interrupted; from Technika 2 all inputs changed to non-interfering.
Modern extensions support up to 1296 slots (01 to ZZ base-36); bmson JSON has no inherent keysound limit and supports automatic stem slicing.
Normalize increases amplitude to 100% with additional phase manipulation that can eke out more dB—considered lossy but should sound identical.
MP3s will always have a gap at beginning (20-30ms) plus added end—must open in Edison, Trim, save as wav to avoid tempo/gap trouble.
No keysound should exceed 60s—LR2IR blocks it. Split vocal stems into ~40s segments.
woslicerIII was updated Sept 22 2013 to operate on Windows XP. CAUTION: woslicerII is not maintained any longer.
